title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.1.1 — Auto-Update Detection Fix & True Real Location Lock
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.1.1:
• Fixed updater false-positive: dynamically reads installed APK version to never show download button when already up to date
• Fixed fake location: dual-tier filter detects and discards emulator mock coordinates (23.804093, 90.415238), locking onto true real-world network coordinates
• Background 10m movement & 1-hour stationary pulses running silently
• Enhanced offline queue sync with timestamp preservation
• Clean Activity UI with zero clutter
